sentences.text:
Amit Kumar Singh @ Amit Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.
Through Its Principal ... on 22 March, 2023

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1358 of 2022
Applicant :- Amit Kumar Singh @ Amit Kumar And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Through Its Principal Secretary Home Department Lucknow
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kr. Yadav Warsi,Pradeep Kumar Tripathi,Vineet Kumar Yad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Abhishek Misra Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.

Heard Shri Santosh Kr. Yadav Warsi, learned counsel for the applicants, Shri Abhishek Misra,
learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.4 as well as learned A.G.A. appearing for opposite party no.1 to 3 and perused the record.

The instant application has been moved by the accused-applicants- Amit Kumar Singh @ Amit Kumar, Kallu Singh, Om Prakash Lodhi and Udai Singh in Case Crime No. 0764 of 2019, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 504 and 506 I.P.C. Police Station Sarojni Nagar, District Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail, as they are apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.

Learned counsel for the applicants while pressing the anticipatory bail application submits that applicant no.3 and 4 are the marginal witness of an alleged agreement to sale executed on 29.10.2018 and the applicant no.2 has been alleged to have executed the said agreement to sale in favour of applicant no.1 without any authority as the owner of the said property was the opposite party no.4 and the applicant no.2 was not having any authority to execute any agreement to sale.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that a civil dispute pertaining to the property in question is pending before Civil Judge Hawali (Junior Division), Lucknow bearing R.S. No. 851 of 2015 in the name of 'Kallu Singh vs. Vishwamohan Singh and Another) with the prayer of cancellation of 'will deed' dated 26.12.2013 executed by Rajendra (deceased) in favour of applicant no.2- Kallu Singh and one case pertaining to Section 34 of U.P. Revenue Code is also pending between the parties in revenue Court.

sentences.text: It is also submitted that after completion of the investigation final report has been submitted in favour of the applicants twice.
However, the further investigation is pending in the matter.

It is next submitted that it is a case whereby any stretch of imagination the custodial interrogation would not be required moreso as the final report has been submitted twice in favour of the applicants and now the further investigation is pending and by ordering further investigation the previous investigation may not be washed away.

It is further submitted that applicants are not having any criminal history nor they are convicted persons and they are co-operating in the investigation and it is in this background the investigating officer did not get any opportunity or occasion to arrest them and they undertake that they will co-operation in the further investigation as well as in the trial and, thus, protection from arrest till conclusion of the further investigation/during the course of trial may be provided to the instant applicants.
Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that after investigation charge has now been submitted against the applicants on 15.09.2022 and having regard to the nature of the accusation against the applicants, they are not entitled for any discretion.
Shri Abhishek Misra, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.4 vehemently opposes the prayer of anticipatory bail of the applicants on the ground that the applicants have not only manufactured false/forged document/agreement sale but have also intimidated the informant and his family members and having regard to the nature of accusation levelled against them, they are not entitled for any discretion.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it has not been disputed by any party that after investigation the final report in the matter was submitted twice and thereafter on 15.09.2022 charge sheet has been submitted against the applicants.
It is submitted on behalf of the applicants that after submission of the charge sheet on 15.09.2022 further investigation has again been ordered.
The determination of culpability of the applicants either in manufacturing the forged 'will' or execution of agreement to sale is the subject matter of trial.

However, having regard to the fact that the applicants are not having any criminal history and it has been twice 'Final Report' (Closure Report) has been submitted by the investigating agency and now after further investigation the charge sheet has been submitted which has also been subjected to further investigation, in the considered opinion of this Court, having regard to the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia vs. State of Punjab; (1980) 2 SCC 655,
Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra : (2011) 1 SCC 694, Sushila Aggarwal v. State (NCT of Delhi) (2020) 5 SCC 1 and in Nathu Singh Vs State of U.P. and Others, 2021(6) SCC 64,
Amit Kumar Singh @ Amit Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. Through Its Principal ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123149959/
2 MANU/SC/0360/2021, protection from arrest may be granted to the applicants during the course of further investigation as well as during the course of trial.
Resultantly, the instant anticipatory bail application moved on behalf of the applicants- Amit Kumar Singh @ Amit Kumar, Kallu Singh, Om Prakash Lodhi and Udai Singh is allowed and it is provided that in the event of arrest of the applicants, involved in the above noted case or on their surrender before the trial court within 15 days from today i.e. before 06.04.2023, whichever is earlier, they shall be released forthwith on anticipatory bail on their furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/-
with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, Station House Officer of the Police Station concerned/ Investigating Officer subject to the following conditions:
1. The applicants if not arrested earlier, shall surrender before the trial court within 15 days from today i.e. on or before 06.04.2023 and will cooperate in the trial.
2. The applicants shall Cooperate in the investigation and will make themselves available as and when required by the Investigating officer of the case, even for the recovery of any fact.
3. The applicants shall not make any attempt to influence the prosecution witnesses and will also not commit any crime during his release on anticipatory bail.
4. The applicants shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence and specially when the prosecution witnesses are present in court.
5. The applicants shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
If in the opinion of the trial court default of any of the condition placed above is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of their bail and shall proceed against them in accordance with law.
It is clarified that all the observations contained in this order are only for disposal of this anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial proceedings in any manner.
